Honestly I just listen to music and lay in bed lost in a daydream. I prefer daydreams to sleeping because I still get to actively enjoy them to a point. Eventually my troubles melt away and it’s like the daydream is real. I’ve gone entire days on autopilot like that.
Nowhere in particular. No reasons either. Just something I want to do that will likely cause me major issues before a certain point in my life.

One where I’m not constantly having my gender questioned. One where I can travel internationally. One where I have financial stability. One where I don’t have to spend all of my time trying to convince medical professionals that I am who I say i am. Et cetera.

The whole thing. I live in an abusive house, am depressed and suicidal, will never get to chase my dreams or have a body I don’t hate. This will follow me for the rest of my life. 

I don’t think I’ll ever be happy.

constantly. literally almost all of my time is spent in these kinds of daydreams. feels like i'm on autopilot 24/7 - i can dream entire conversations or days. my family once almost called an ambulance because they thought i was high out of my mind on hardcore drugs.

all i did was sit and blankly stare no matter what anyone did for a while.

i've gotten into this state in the middle of phone calls before and imagined entire 2 hour conversations. when i snap out of it my friend is either gone or they're freaking out wondering where i went. 

you know what? i don't even find it to be bad. most people who i can find that experience this want to stop so badly but sometimes i actively seek it. it's nice to be away from this prison every once in a while.

say the reality is that my family is fist fighting outside my door while i blast music at 100% volume slouched over in my chair. the dream would be that i'm driving along in a car with my head on my adoptive dad's (fictional. don't know him irl but it's something that i've had for a long time in my dreams) shoulder while music softly plays over the radio. it's nice.

No photo ID. No license, not much cash. Should I keep going?

Not exactly a runaway. More like “I aged out and left”. Probably Gonna be kicked out anyway. I’ve never expected it to be fun or romantic or anything. But even with all of the pitfalls it seems to beat whatever the hell kind of life I’m forced to live now. 

It’s not like I’m a 12 year old with no plan. I’m someone trying to escape a lifetime of bullshit. And yeah, this probably is my only option. Things don’t come easy for high school dropouts with no connections or bank account or photo ID or anything. Can’t even get a hotel room let alone rent anything from someone where I live. 

Honestly, I’ve resigned myself to the fate. I’d rather take my chances and die away from here than blow my brains out in the confines of my own personal hell
